goal: Webhook inbox'ındaki doğrulanmış refund/chargeback olaylarını mevcut payment transition ve invoice review handoff'una bağlamak
rollback: Bu paketin webhook mapping/wiring ve test değişikliklerini geri al; payment, invoice, document veya delivery verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Only signature-verified, tenant-scoped and payment-bound webhook metadata can produce refund/partial-refund/chargeback transitions
Mapped refund/chargeback events use the existing payment transaction and invoice review handoff boundary
Duplicate, unsupported, contradictory or incomplete provider events remain idempotent and fail-closed
Existing succeeded/failed/processing webhook behavior and invoice snapshot handoff remain unchanged
